q: Which 5 stations were empty most often?
sql: SELECT s.name FROM snapshots r JOIN stations s USING (station_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNTIF(r.bikes = 0) DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

q: How many bikes were available at the latest reading?
sql: SELECT SUM(bikes) FROM snapshots WHERE slot = (SELECT MAX(slot) FROM snapshots)

q: At what hour are stations most often empty?
sql: SELECT local_hour FROM snapshots GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNTIF(bikes = 0) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the total capacity of all stations?
What percentage of available bikes are electric?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(ebike) / SUM(bikes), 1) FROM snapshots

q: How many stations had no bikes at the latest reading?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM snapshots WHERE bikes = 0 AND slot = (SELECT MAX(slot) FROM snapshots)

q: Which station has the largest capacity?
sql: SELECT name FROM stations ORDER BY capacity DESC, name LIMIT 1

q: What is the average number of bikes per reading on weekends?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(bikes), 1) FROM snapshots WHERE is_weekend = 1

q: What is the average number of bikes per reading on weekdays?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(bikes), 1) FROM snapshots WHERE is_weekend = 0

q: At what hour are the most bikes available in total?
sql: SELECT local_hour FROM snapshots GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(bikes) DESC LIMIT 1

q: On which date were stations empty the most often?
sql: SELECT local_date FROM snapshots GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNTIF(bikes = 0) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which 3 stations have the highest average number of bikes?
sql: SELECT s.name FROM snapshots r JOIN stations s USING (station_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(r.bikes) DESC, 1 LIMIT 3
